A0_S1_D1: ^A birthday tune is hummed as you sit around a campfire with your family, embers floating by your feet.
^“We are gathered here today to celebrate the coming of age of our dear Noelle. Next in line to the Tempest family name,”
^“the finest of any family here on this little island.”
^“A beacon of hope against any and all creatures that lurk in the shadow.”
^“Are you ready to make all of us proud?”
^You stare at the chalice, then at your grandfather and parents. Eager claps follow as you nod.
^You take a gulp. The taste of iron spreads on your tongue.
^In seconds, you begin to choke and fall to your knees, struggling to catch your breath.
^“You made it, Theodore. Are you trying to destroy the last of our legacy?!”
^“How could you, to our own daughter—!”
^“No no, of course not! I followed the recipe exactly! It shouldn’t be affecting her like this!”
^Shadows swarm around you. Did your father really…?
^Their outbursts dim as something rough and painful peels against your face.
^And all of a sudden, the arguing stops.
^You notice the claws that now tip your fingers. Gasps.
^Your grandfather’s gnarled, bony finger points at you.
^Your mother’s expression twists into something deeper than anger.
^“Well this is great— just great! Our only heir, a monster!”
^“You didn’t tell me there was a monster on your side of the family.” She says to your father.
^A chill runs down your spine as your mother turns to you.
^“Now listen here, this is what happened—”
^“Our darling Noelle was moments away from completing her coming of age ritual when a vicious monster attacked.”
^“The creature was ultimately slain by yours truly, but at the tragic cost of our daughter’s life.”
^“How terrible today is, for the Tempest family to be robbed of its only heir, by one of them no less.”
^"You can’t do this! I’m your daughter!”
^“Not anymore. Not after what you've become.”
^Your mother’s eyes grow manic. The knife in her hand glints.
^It takes everything in you to not stumble as you run, and run, and run.
^“You really had to go and ruin this for everyone, didn’t you?” Your mother snarls.
^Clouds are gathering as you reach the nearest boat. Your hands fumble, nerves alight.
^“I suppose we’ll need to find a replacement.” Your mother’s voice pursues you.
^“Anything to erase the mark of a monster in our midst.”
^…The Island of Dusk lives in seclusion from the rest of the world. Priding itself on its natural ecosystem, void of dangerous creatures.
^You watch as the very teachings cooed to you as a child transform into pitched forks.
^You are a monster plucked from the worst imaginations.
^Thunder and lightning flashes as you board a small ship.
^“Goodbye, Noelle. May the gods have mercy on your soul.”
^Rain is bucketing down from the sky.
^“Run and run, and never come back!”
^You aren’t sure if the howling voices are real or figments of your imagination.
^But something dark seems to twist beneath the sea.
